transcript.en: I've brought my notes on our Biology Field Trip to Rocky Bay, Colin,
transcript.zh: Colin，我把去Rocky Bay生物实地考察时做的笔记带过来了，

transcript.en: so we can work on our report on the research we did together.
transcript.zh: 现在我们就可以根据一起做的调查把报告写出来了。

transcript.en: OK. I've got mine too. Let's look at the aims of the trip first.
transcript.zh: 好的，我把我做的笔记也带来了。我们先来看看这次考察的目的。

transcript.en: Right. What did you have?
transcript.zh: 对，关于这一点你记了什么内容？

transcript.en: I just put something about getting experience of the different sorts of procedures used on a field trip.
transcript.zh: 我就写了获得在实地考察中要采用的不同步骤的相关经验。

transcript.en: But we need something about what causes different organisms to choose particular habitats.
transcript.zh: 但是我们需要的是导致不同生物选择特定栖息地的原因。

transcript.en: I agree. And something about finding out how to protect organisms in danger of dying out?
transcript.zh: 我同意，还有探究如何才能保护濒临灭绝的生物。

transcript.en: In our aims?
transcript.zh: 把这一点包括在目的里吗？

transcript.en: But we weren't really looking at that.
transcript.zh: 可是我们当时没怎么关注这个问题啊。

transcript.en: I suppose not.
transcript.zh: 好像是没有哦。

transcript.en: OK, now there's the list of equipment we all had to bring on the field trip.
transcript.zh: 那好吧，现在我们要列一个所有人去实地考察时都要携带的装备的清单。

transcript.en: What did they tell us to bring a ruler for?
transcript.zh: 他们当初叫我们带尺子去是为了什么？

transcript.en: It was something about measuring the slope of the shore,
transcript.zh: 那是为了测量海岸的倾斜度，

transcript.en: but of course we didn't need it because we were measuring wind direction, and we'd brought the compass for that...
transcript.zh: 不过当然了，我们俩用不着它，因为我们测量的是风向，为此我们还带了指南针......

transcript.en: But not the piece of string to hold up in the air!
transcript.zh: 但不是那根悬在空中的绳子！

transcript.en: Didn't Mr Blake make a fuss about us leaving that behind.
transcript.zh: 我们忘记把绳子带走的时候，Mr.Blake是不是还吵闹了好一阵？

transcript.en: Yeah. He does go on.
transcript.zh: 对，他确实有点小题大做。

transcript.en: Anyway it was easy to get one from another of the students.
transcript.zh: 不管怎样，从别的同学那里借一根来容易得很。

transcript.en: Now, the next section's the procedure.
transcript.zh: 那下一部分就是步骤啦，

transcript.en: I sent you the draft of that.
transcript.zh: 我给你发了一份这部分的草稿。

transcript.en: Yeah. It was clear, but I don't think we need all these details of what time we left and what time we got back and how we divided up the different research tasks.
transcript.zh: 我看见了，草稿上的步骤很清晰，但是我觉得并不需要那么详细，比如我们不需要把离开的时间、回来的时间和怎样分配的不同调查任务都罗列出来。

transcript.en: OK. I'll look at that again.
transcript.zh: 好吧，我会再修改一下的。

transcript.en: Then we have to describe our method of investigation in detail.
transcript.zh: 接下来要详细描述一下我们的调查方法。

transcript.en: So let's begin with how we measured wave speed.
transcript.zh: 我们从测量波速开始吧。

transcript.en: I was surprised how straightforward that was.
transcript.zh: 这个简单得让我有点惊讶。

transcript.en: I'd expected us to have some sort of high-tech device, not just stand there and count the number of waves per minute.
transcript.zh: 我之前还以为要用一些高科技设备呢，没想到只是站在那儿，数每分钟有多少波浪。

transcript.en: Not very precise, but I suppose it was good enough.
transcript.zh: 虽然得出的结果没那么精确，但是我觉得已经够好了。

transcript.en: But the way we measured the amount of salt was interesting.
transcript.zh: 不过我们测量盐度时使用的方法还蛮有趣的。

transcript.en: In the water from the rock pools?
transcript.zh: 你指的是测量从潮水坑里取出的水的盐度？

transcript.en: Yeah, I wanted to check the chemicals we used in the lab when we analysed those samples - was it potassium chromate and silver nitrate?
transcript.zh: 没错。对了，我想确认一下在实验室分析那些样品时使用的化学制剂，我们用的是铬酸钾和硝酸银，对吗？

transcript.en: That's right.
transcript.zh: 对的。

transcript.en: Ok, and we need the map of the seashore
transcript.zh: 好的，我们需要海滩地图。

transcript.en: You just left that to me.
transcript.zh: 你当时直接把这个任务交给我了。

transcript.en: And I had to do it while the tide was low, well that was OK, but the place I started it from was down on the beach,
transcript.zh: 而我得趁着退潮的时候把它搞定，这也没什么，但是我开始的时候是在海滩上地势比较低的地方，

transcript.en: then I realized I should have gone up higher to get better visibility, so I had to start all over again.
transcript.zh: 然后我就意识到应该去地势更高的地方视野才好，于是我又得全部从头来过。

transcript.en: But at least I'd got the squared paper or I'd have had problems drawing it all to scale.
transcript.zh: 不过好在我带的是方格纸，不然想要全部按规定比例画出来就太困难了。

transcript.en: Yes. It looks good. We could get a map of the region off the internet and see if we need to make any changes.
transcript.zh: 对，你画的地图看起来不错。我们可以从网上下载一张那个地区的地图，看看有没有要修改的地方。

transcript.en: I had a look but I couldn't find anything.
transcript.zh: 我看过一眼网上的地图，但是没找到任何要改的地方。

transcript.en: But you took some pictures, didn't you?
transcript.zh: 不过你照了一些照片，对吗？

transcript.en: Yeah. I'll email you them if you want.
transcript.zh: 嗯，如果你要的话，我用邮件把它们发给你。

transcript.en: OK. I'll make my amendments using those, then I can scan it into our report. Great.
transcript.zh: 好，我过会儿参照这些照片做一些修改，然后就可以把地图扫描成电子版，放进我们的报告里了。太棒了。

transcript.en: Now when we get to our findings I thought we could divide them up into the different zones we identified on the shore and the problems organisms face in each zone.
transcript.zh: 在写发现部分的内容时，我觉得我们可以根据在海岸上识别出的不同地区，把这些发现成果加以划分，然后再写出每个区的生物面临的问题。

transcript.en: So for the highest area...
transcript.zh: 那么在最高的地区.....

transcript.en: ...the splash zone?
transcript.zh: 你指的是飞溅区？

transcript.en: Yeah, we found mostly those tiny shellfish that have strong hard shells that act as protection.
transcript.zh: 对，我们在那儿发现的大多都是些小小的贝类，就是那些用硬壳来保护自己的生物。

transcript.en: But not from other organisms that might eat them, predators?
transcript.zh: 但是它们没法保护自己不被其他生物捕食啊，比如食肉动物？

transcript.en: No, that's not the main danger for them.
transcript.zh: 不，那不是它们面临的主要危险。

transcript.en: But the shells prevent them from drying out because they're in the open air for most of the time.
transcript.zh: 这些壳能防止它们过多流失水分，因为它们大部分时间都在露天环境中。

transcript.en: Right. And since they're exposed, they need to be able to find some sort of shelter, or cover themselves up, so they don't get too hot.
transcript.zh: 对，而且既然它们已经暴露在空气中了，就要找到某种庇护所，或者把自己遮盖起来，这样才不会过热。

transcript.en: Then in the middle and lower zones, nearer the sea, we need to discuss the effects of wave action...
transcript.zh: 接着关于离海较近的中部地区和地势较低的地区，我们要讨论一下海浪作用的影响...

transcript.en: Yes, and how organisms develop structures to prevent themselves from being swept away, or even destroyed by being smashed against the rocks.
transcript.zh: 是的，以及生物是如何发展出某种结构，以防止自己被海浪冲走或者甚至被海浪拍到石头上摔死的。

transcript.en: I haven't done anything on the geological changes.
transcript.zh: 我没做过任何关于地质变迁方面的调查。

transcript.en: I don't know what to put for that.
transcript.zh: 不知道在这方面要写什么。

transcript.en: No, we weren't concentrating on that.
transcript.zh: 嗯，我也没有，我们当时没有关注这方面。

transcript.en: Maybe we need to find some websites.
transcript.zh: 也许我们需要去一些网站上寻找信息。

transcript.en: Good idea. I've got the lecture notes from Mr Blake's geology course, but they're too general.
transcript.zh: 好主意。我有Mr.Blake的地质学课上的笔记，不过都太笼统了。

transcript.en: But we could ask him which books on our Reading List might be most helpful.
transcript.zh: 但是我们可以问问他阅读清单上的哪些书可能最有帮助。

transcript.en: Right. OK, now I did a draft of the section of sources of possible error in our research, but I don't know if you agree.
transcript.zh: 没错。我把我们调查时可能出现的错误的原因这一部分写了份草稿，不过我不知道你会不会同意我的观点。

transcript.en: For example, the size of the sample, and whether it's big enough to make any general conclusions from.
transcript.zh: 比如样品的范围，以及它是否大到可以从中得出任何一般性结论。

transcript.en: But I thought actually we did have quite a big sample.
transcript.zh: 不过实际上我觉得我们的取样范围已经够大了。

transcript.en: We did. And our general method of observation seemed quite reliable.
transcript.zh: 没错，而且我们总体的观察方法好像也很可靠啊。

transcript.en: But we might not be all that accurate as far as the actual numbers go.
transcript.zh: 不过我们得出的数据可能没有真实数据那么精确。

transcript.en: Yeah, we might have missed some organisms - if they were hiding under a rock, for example.
transcript.zh: 对，我们也许遗漏了一些生物，比如那些躲在岩石下面的。

transcript.en: I wasn't sure about the way we described their habitats.
transcript.zh: 我对我们描述它们栖息地的方式不太有把握。

transcript.en: I decided it was probably OK.
transcript.zh: 不过我觉得应该没问题。

transcript.en: Yeah, and the descriptions we gave of the smaller organisms, they weren't very detailed, but they were adequate in this context.
transcript.zh: 对，虽然我们给出的关于小型生物的描述不是特别详细，但是用在这里已经足够了。

transcript.en: I'm not sure we identified all the species correctly though.
transcript.zh: 不过，我不确定我们有没有准确辨认出所有的物种。

transcript.en: OK, we'd better mention that. Now, how...
transcript.zh: 好吧，那我们最好提一下这一点。我们怎么......
